entities.title: dagre
entities.summary: The layout library that places parts and routes lines.
entities.relevance: Version 3.1.3 is loaded from jsDelivr; the page uses its compound graphs, ranks and edge points.

entities.title: Barlow on Fontsource
entities.summary: The typeface family, in three widths.
entities.relevance: Barlow, Barlow Semi Condensed and Barlow Condensed are loaded from Fontsource's packages on jsDelivr.

entities.title: GitHub REST API: get a tree
entities.summary: How a GitHub repository is listed.
entities.relevance: The page lists a repository with one recursive tree call, which GitHub may truncate.

entities.title: GitHub REST API: repository contents
entities.summary: How a file is read with a token.
entities.relevance: With a token, files are read here with Accept: application/vnd.github.raw.

entities.title: GitHub REST API rate limits
entities.summary: 60 requests an hour without a token, 5,000 with one.
entities.relevance: Sets how many repositories a reader without a token can open.

entities.title: GitLab API: repository tree
entities.summary: How a GitLab project is listed.
entities.relevance: The page lists a project's tree, a hundred entries to a page.

entities.title: GitLab API: repository files
entities.summary: How a GitLab file is read.
entities.relevance: Each .dev file is read raw, with the token as PRIVATE-TOKEN.

entities.title: WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices: tabs
entities.summary: The keyboard pattern the kind tabs follow.
entities.relevance: Arrow keys, Home and End move between tabs; only the open tab is in the tab order.
